# `/jit-activation-history` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /jit-activation-history/v1

`listJitActivationHistoryV1` — List JIT activation history (admin) — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns JIT activation history records for the tenant. This is the admin/operator view - it returns activations across all identities in the tenant. Requires `idn:jit-activation-history:read`. Returns HTTP 403 when the `PSPM_858_JIT_ACCESS_ACTIVATION_HISTORY_SEARCH` feature flag is disabled.

- Scopes: idn:jit-activation-history:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: activationInitiated, provisionCompleted, status Default sort is -activationInitiated (newest first). — e.g. `-activationInitiated`
  - `searchAfter` (query) — Used to begin the search window at the values specified. This parameter consists of the last values of the sorted fields in the current record set. searchAfter length must match the number of…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: identityId: eq, in; entitlementId: eq, in; sourceId: eq; connectionId: eq; status: eq, in; activationInitiated: gt, lt, ge, le; policyFrictionOutcome: eq, in — e.g. `status eq "PROVISIONED"`
- Returns 200: array of jitactivationhistorydocument

### GET /jit-activation-history/v1/current-identity

`listJitActivationHistoryForCurrentIdentityV1` — List JIT activation history (self) — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns JIT activation history records for the authenticated identity only. This is the self-service view - results are automatically scoped to the calling identity. Requires `idn:jit-activation-history-self:read`. Returns HTTP 403 when the `PSPM_858_JIT_ACCESS_ACTIVATION_HISTORY_SEARCH` feature flag is disabled.
